scientific_integrity: Universal integral theorem proved by explicit simplicial collapses and wedge/Mayer-Vietoris arguments; standalone finite checker corroborates but is not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only triangle-free connected cacti; no assertion for triangular blocks, overlapping cycle blocks, higher Čech scales, or a full persistence barcode. Long-cycle subfamily and individual C4 calculation were previously known. Independently unvalidated.
title: Square-cycle localization in closed-neighborhood complexes of triangle-free cactus line graphs
